generation_method: Template-driven with ground-truth labels assigned by construction
key_fixes: Labels are now assigned BEFORE text generation, not analyzed after
Each template group has explicit sentiment_manual, emotional_label, severity, clinical_status
sentiment_score is randomized within the correct range for each sentiment_manual category
Synonym substitution and variation phrases ensure zero exact duplicates
Text is crafted to NATURALLY express the assigned emotion
